content_of_post_to_comment: I feel like motivational quotes do very little when you are struggling deeply. What seems to help is someone listening without trying to fix anything. I'm not fully dismissing quotes. I like a good one. But motivation tends to come back after someone feels heard, not before.
comment: Sometimes advice feels like another thing you’re failing at when you barely have the energy to get through the day. Being listened to takes that pressure away for a bit. You don’t have to turn your pain into a lesson or immediately do something about it. Funny enough, that breathing room can be what makes taking the next step feel possible.
